visualCharacteristics.purpose: self-contained tab component switching between tier panels, each with intro text and a row of icon features
visualCharacteristics.layout: horizontal tab strip (scrolls on small screens) above one visible panel; panel intro centered, icon features in equal columns on desktop, stacked on mobile

contentPattern.structure: one row per tab: cell 1 is the tab label; cell 2 is the panel: eyebrow paragraph, tier name heading, tagline paragraph, then per feature an icon (image or :icon:) followed by a heading and a paragraph

cells: Tab content: eyebrow paragraph, tier name heading, tagline paragraph, then per feature an icon image, a heading and a paragraph

usage: Membership tiers or any set of mutually exclusive panels that live in one section.
reuseGuidance: Use when all tab content fits in one block. When each tab needs whole sections with their own blocks, use advanced-tabs instead.
